title: Bronze Barrel
description: <keyword>Bronze barrels</keyword> can be used to store and move <keyword>32 stacks</keyword> of one item.
• <positive>Left-click</positive> to give a stack to a placed barrel (<positive>shift</positive> to give as much as possible).
• <positive>Right-click</positive> to take a stack from a placed barrel (<positive>shift</positive> to take only 1 item).
If you <positive>break</positive> a barrel it will keep its stored contents, and you will get an item that you can interact with.
• Left-click on a barrel item with an item to insert it into the barrel.
• Left-click the barrel item on an empty slot to extract some items from it.
